entries: **The weekly quota warning no longer fires from a short burst of use, and the time it shows now matches the reason it fired** ([#138](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/138)). It used to extrapolate only the last 30–60 minutes of burn rate onto the 7-day window, so a dense working session alone could trigger a false alarm (e.g. 53.7% used, 3 days 1 hour to reset, warned "runs out in 13 hours"). `assess_weekly_quota()` now checks both rates: the short window still warns immediately if it alone predicts exhaustion within an hour, but otherwise the whole-week average must predict exhaustion at least 20% of the reset window early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before it warns — and displays that average's time instead of the short window's, which previously could show a number like "runs out in 8h55m" next to a warning actually driven by a slower week-long trend, contradicting the separate 5-hour session quota shown beside it. Session-quota warnings are unchanged.

**The Windows tray panel could stay stuck at `--` and Loading forever when `~/.claude/settings.json` had a UTF-8 BOM.** `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, and Python's JSON decoder rejects an otherwise-valid file that starts with a BOM with `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM`, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop ever completed. Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

The interface now displays the time predicted by the whole-week average, eliminating confusing scenarios where "runs out in 8h55m" contradicted the adjacent 5-hour session quota; rules for 5-hour session quota warnings remain unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣支援 UTF-8 BOM 設定檔，徹底告別卡死與載入中
title.en: Windows system tray supports UTF-8 BOM config files, resolving freezes and endless loading

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上，當 Claude 設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 帶有 UTF-8 BOM（位元組順序記號，部分編輯器在開頭加入的隱藏標記），系統匣面板不再卡在 `--` 與 Loading。過去 `installer/setup_hook.py` 用一般 `utf-8` 開啟檔案，Python 的解析器把開頭帶 BOM 的有效檔案判為 `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` 錯誤，導致啟動自我修復步驟在刷新迴圈跑完前就失敗。現在 `_load_settings()` 與舊版遷移邏輯皆改用 `utf-8-sig`，不論檔案有無 BOM 都能正常讀取且設定內容不變。⟦這宛如收發窗口先前看到信件開頭多了一枚印章，就誤判整份合規公文無效而拒絕拆閱；換上相容的判讀方式後，運作才重回正軌。⟧
body.en: On Windows, when Claude's config file `~/.claude/settings.json` contains a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark, a hidden marker added at the beginning by some editors), the system tray panel no longer gets stuck at `--` and Loading. Previously, `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, causing Python's parser to reject valid files with a BOM with an `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` error, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop could complete. Now, both `_load_settings()` and the legacy migration logic use `utf-8-sig`, reading the file properly whether a BOM is present or not without altering parsed settings. ⟦This is like a mailroom rejecting a valid official document simply because it has an extra stamp at the top; switching to a compatible reading method puts operations back on track.⟧

Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

entries: **The report's date range can be changed inside the page** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). The HTML report used to freeze its period at generation time, so a copy sent to someone else could not be explored. A day × tool × model × project table (about 80 KB) is now embedded, and every date-dependent section recalculates in the browser from five shortcuts or a custom from/to range in a sticky bar. No app and no regeneration are needed, so a shared file stays fully usable. Sections that always cover a fixed span say so, so they don't look broken when the dates change.

**Report history survives transcript cleanup.** The report recomputed everything from `~/.claude/projects` and `~/.codex/sessions`, which grow by roughly 1.9 GB a month, so deleting old transcripts erased report history with them. Totals are now kept in `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` at (session, date, tool, model, project) grain, plus each session's start time and duration so the session ranking survives too. When a day's live transcripts hold fewer tokens than the snapshot, that day is replayed from the snapshot; stored costs are used as-is rather than repriced against today's price list. On real data, reports for today / week / last 7 days / month / all were byte-identical except for the generation time with transcripts present and with all of them simulated as deleted.
**Daily usage chart.** A stacked bar per day, coloured by tool, with a Tokens/Cost toggle, a hover breakdown, and redraws when the date range changes.

**Cost confidence.** Shows how much usage has a public price and how much does not, names the unpriced models, and states plainly that cost is the API-equivalent value from public price lists, not a subscription bill.

**The report is reorganised around what people read first.** Order is now summary cards → usage trend → your tools → projects → costliest sessions → the fixed-span group (heatmap, habits, recent work, insights) → how these numbers are calculated → Year in Review. The main-model section repeated the tools section's numbers exactly, so it is gone; each tool row now expands to show its models, and expanded rows stay open when the date range changes. The project donut repeated the ranking below it and was removed. "Weekly burn trend" is now "Usage trend". Token mix, cache hit rate and cost confidence live in a collapsed "How these numbers are calculated" card. The five "fixed range" tags became one note above the group they apply to.

**Visual pass across the report.** Filled bars behind ranking, tool, composition and weekly rows became 2px tracks along the bottom edge; only token figures stay yellow. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that lead with the abbreviated number and show the exact count underneath. Section spacing and title sizes are consistent, every section shares one left and right edge, and expandable rows highlight on hover. On phones, a project is one line instead of four, a tool is two lines instead of four, the session table scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, and the heatmap keeps readable cells and opens scrolled to the latest weeks.
**The summary sentence no longer states a project count.** Projects are attributed by working folder, so non-git folders and replayed history still inflate the number enough to mislead.
**Grok is pink in the report.** Its previous green sat next to Claude's green in the stacked daily chart and the two could not be told apart.

**Claude sessions opened in a repo subfolder no longer count as separate projects.** `adapters/claude.py` used only the last folder name, so `tests/`, `docs/` and `panels/` each became a project. It now uses the same `resolve_project_name()` git lookup as Codex, Grok and Antigravity, and the shared cache grew from 256 to 2048 entries so several tools' folders together don't push it into repeated `git` calls. Days that can only be replayed from the snapshot keep the folder names recorded at the time.
**Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)), which produced growth like `↑2799%`.
**A tool group with one unpriced model no longer hides its whole cost** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); Antigravity's $166 had been shown as `—`.

**Collapsed rows actually collapse** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` outranked the browser's `[hidden]`, so collapsing changed the DOM but not the screen.
**Session ranking bars no longer pile up in the top-left corner** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); `.tokens-cell` was missing `position:relative`.

**Expanded model rows are no longer wider than their parent.** Child bars were drawn as share-of-project on the same scale as the parent's share-of-total, so a model at 68.7% of a project looked three times bigger than the project itself.

title.zh-TW: Claude 子目錄工作階段依 Git 歸屬專案，快取擴大防止重複查詢
title.en: Claude sessions in subdirectories attributed to parent repo via Git, with expanded cache preventing repeated lookups

body.zh-TW: 在專案子資料夾啟動 Claude，用量現在會正確歸入同一個母專案。過去 `adapters/claude.py` 處理工作階段（session）只取路徑最後一層名稱，導致 `tests/`、`docs/` 或 `panels/` 都被誤算成獨立專案。新版改用與 Codex、Grok 及 Antigravity 相同的 `resolve_project_name()` 判斷 git 根目錄。為了避免多個工具的資料夾加總後反覆呼叫 `git`，共用快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）上限從 256 筆調升至 2048 筆。只能從小計快照還原的舊日期，則沿用當時記下的資料夾名稱。⟦這彷彿收發室先前只看包裹的辦公室門牌，把同一部門信件拆給不同客戶；改查大樓總地址後，信件才正確歸入同案。⟧
body.en: Launching Claude inside a project subfolder now correctly attributes usage to the same parent project. Previously, `adapters/claude.py` handled sessions by taking only the last folder name in the path, causing `tests/`, `docs/`, or `panels/` to be miscounted as standalone projects. The new version switches to `resolve_project_name()`, matching Codex, Grok, and Antigravity to determine the git root. To avoid repeated `git` calls when aggregating folders across multiple tools, the shared cache limit was raised from 256 to 2048 entries. Older dates that can only be replayed from subtotal snapshots retain the folder names recorded at that time. ⟦It is as if a mailroom previously looked only at office door numbers on packages, sorting letters for the same department into different client bins; checking the building's main address finally routes every mail item to the correct project.⟧

title.zh-TW: 報表修復排版與圖表比例，校準前期統計與混合計價

An issue where `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` overrode the browser's `[hidden]` attribute has been fixed, ensuring collapsed rows actually collapse. Adding `position:relative` to `.tokens-cell` prevents session ranking bars from piling up in the top-left corner. Expanded model sub-rows now use corrected scaling rather than plotting project share on the total-volume scale, preventing a model accounting for 68.7% of a project from looking three times larger than the project itself. ⟦This is like proofing a ledger's layout: calibrating baseline comparison dates, properly hiding collapsed rows, repositioning overlapping bars, and preventing sub-items from being drawn longer than the total.⟧

**Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)), which produced growth like `↑2799%`.
**A tool group with one unpriced model no longer hides its whole cost** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); Antigravity's $166 had been shown as `—`.
**Collapsed rows actually collapse** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` outranked the browser's `[hidden]`, so collapsing changed the DOM but not the screen.

**Expanded model rows are no longer wider than their parent.** Child bars were drawn as share-of-project on the same scale as the parent's share-of-total, so a model at 68.7% of a project looked three times bigger than the project itself.

entries: **No more black console windows flashing at Windows startup** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). `usage.exe` is packaged without a console, but no `subprocess` call in the project passed `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, so Windows created and closed a console window for every child process. The flash count equalled the number of distinct project directories in the Claude history — `resolve_project_name()` runs `git worktree list --porcelain` once per directory and caches per process, so every launch repeated it. A shared `usage_common/subprocess_utils.py` now supplies the `creationflags`, every child process in the project goes through it, and the missing `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL` was added along the way. `usage_session_resume.py` and `usage_statusline_forwarder.py` are copied verbatim into `~/.claude/` and run by the system Python, so they keep an inlined equivalent instead of importing the project; a new test uses `ast` to keep every copied-out script free of project imports. The forwarder also had no version-upgrade path at all — `_copy_forwarder_script()` was only called on reinstall or when the state looked broken — so it gained `FORWARDER_VERSION` and a `self_heal()` upgrade step like the other hooks.

**The Windows panel no longer flashes at its old position before moving.** pywebview's WinForms backend passes `SWP_SHOWWINDOW` in both `resize()` and `move()`, so the `resize()` in `_place_window_on_ui_thread()` made the still-hidden window visible at the previous coordinates; the following `move()` then moved it and only then did `show()` run. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the window sat visible in the wrong place for 36 ms, about two frames. Position and size are now applied while the window is hidden in a single `SetWindowPos` without `SWP_SHOWWINDOW`, leaving display to the existing `show()` path; without a native handle, or off Windows, it falls back to `resize()` + `move()` unchanged. Applying geometry is also skipped entirely when the current physical-pixel geometry already matches, so `_apply_content_height_now()` no longer makes a pointless native call when the content height has not changed.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板不再先閃現舊位置，單次設定尺寸坐標徹底消除跳動
title.en: Windows panel no longer flashes at old position, single geometry update eliminates jumpiness

body.zh-TW: 點開 Windows 面板時，畫面不再先在舊坐標閃爍一下才跳回定位。pywebview 的 WinForms 後端在 resize() 與 move() 都帶 SWP_SHOWWINDOW，使 _place_window_on_ui_thread() 提早在舊坐標顯示視窗，隨後才移到定點。以 1 毫秒取樣實測，面板在錯位可見 36 毫秒，約兩個畫面幀。現在視窗改在隱藏時以單次 SetWindowPos 一起設定位置與大小且不帶顯示旗標，顯示交由 show() 處理；非 Windows 或取不到原生視窗時退回既有備援流程。套用前也會先比對目前的實體像素幾何，完全相同便跳過，避免 _apply_content_height_now() 在高度未變時白白呼叫。⟦這種穿幫宛如舞台劇換幕，道具桌還留在上一場的站位，工作人員就失手拉開布幕才急忙把它推定位。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows panel, the screen no longer flashes briefly at its old coordinates before snapping into position. The WinForms backend of pywebview passed SWP_SHOWWINDOW in both resize() and move(), causing _place_window_on_ui_thread() to prematurely display the window at previous coordinates before moving it to its target location. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the panel was visible in the wrong position for 36 ms, or about two frames. The window now sets position and size together via a single SetWindowPos without show flags while hidden, leaving display to show(), and falls back to the existing fallback flow off Windows or when native handles are unavailable. It also compares the current physical-pixel geometry before applying and skips entirely if identical, preventing _apply_content_height_now() from being called unnecessarily when height is unchanged. ⟦This glitch is like a stage scene change where the prop table is still at the previous scene's spot when staff accidentally pull open the curtain before hastily shoving it into place.⟧

entries: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

**The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

**The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

**The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

**Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

body.zh-TW: 使用 3840x2160 高解析度螢幕並開啟 250% 縮放時，Windows 面板現在會準確開在畫面之內。⟦這好比木工師傅照著設計圖施工，助手卻誤把圖面上的公尺當成公分再放大換算，讓做好的櫃子直接卡死在牆角。⟧底層套件 `pywebview 6.2.1` 回傳的螢幕範圍明明是實體像素，卻標記成縮放 1.0。後續 `move()` 與 `resize()` 又拿視窗自身 DPI 重複相乘，使得預設水平坐標被算成 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448，將面板釘在右下角邊緣，且該位置還被存檔讓每次重開都重演。現在程式只在主螢幕回報 1.0 且視窗 DPI 不是 96 時，才用視窗自己的 DPI 將螢幕矩形換算回邏輯像素，避免未來 `pywebview` 修好時重複換算；同時將 `window.show()` 排在擺位之後，面板絕不再閃現在舊位置。

body.zh-TW: 外接不同螢幕工作的讀者，若各螢幕設定了不同的縮放比例，關閉 Windows 面板後重新開啟，它現在會老實回到當初關閉的那台螢幕。先前系統儲存面板位置時，是把實體像素除以視窗當下所在螢幕的 DPI；這導致在 225% 縮放螢幕上關閉的面板，重新開啟時卻莫名其妙彈回 100% 的主螢幕。新版改為直接儲存實體像素，等到擺放面板位置時，才搭配視窗當下的 DPI 進行換算。⟦這如同在不同比例尺的地圖之間穿梭，標記位置時若除以當前圖紙比例，重新翻開時便會走樣跳回起點；改存真實公尺距離後，在哪張地圖合上就在哪張地圖展開。⟧這項改進完全不改變偏好設定的鍵名與資料格式。
body.en: For users working with external monitors configured with different scale factors, closing the Windows panel and reopening it now reliably returns it to the specific display where it was closed. Previously, the system saved the panel's position by dividing physical pixels by the DPI of whichever display the window was currently on; as a result, a panel closed on a 225% scaling display would unexpectedly jump back to the 100% primary screen upon reopening. The new version saves positions directly in physical pixels and only converts them using the window's current DPI when placing the panel. ⟦This is like navigating between maps of different scales: if marked locations are divided by the current sheet's ratio, reopening them distorts the coordinates back to the starting point; storing the actual meter distances instead ensures that whichever map you close on is where you reopen.⟧ This improvement leaves preference key names and data formats completely unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板放寬矮螢幕縮放下限，按鈕與狀態列不再裁切
title.en: Windows panel relaxes zoom floor on short displays, preventing buttons and status row from being cut off

body.zh-TW: 把 Windows 面板開在偏矮的螢幕上時，若曾碰過重新整理或結束按鈕被切出畫面外的窘境，現在這類版面裁切問題已徹底解決。⟦這彷彿在低矮的天花板下擺放展示架，若硬性規定層架間隔不能縮小，最底層的控制旋鈕就會被地面擋住；按空間比例動態調降底線，底部按鍵才不被擠出視野。⟧過去面板設有 0.6 的縮放下限，卻未考慮視窗自身的 DPI，使得 2560x1440 搭配 225% 縮放時，面板被卡在比實際需要更大的縮放比例，導致速率與狀態列以及重新整理和結束按鈕全部掉出畫面之外。現在 Windows 將縮放下限改為 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`，確保文字顯示依然絕不小於 100% 螢幕的 0.6 倍，同時讓整張面板順利塞進螢幕內；macOS 則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When opening the Windows panel on shorter screens, any issues where the Refresh or Quit buttons were cut off outside the viewport are now completely resolved. ⟦This is like placing a display rack under a low ceiling: if shelf spacing is rigidly forbidden from shrinking, the bottom control knobs get blocked by the floor; dynamically lowering the floor based on available space keeps bottom buttons from being squeezed out of view.⟧ Previously, the panel enforced a 0.6 zoom floor without accounting for the window's own DPI, causing the panel at 2560x1440 with 225% scaling to remain stuck above the zoom level it actually needed, which pushed the rate and status row as well as the Refresh and Quit buttons entirely off-screen. Windows now changes the zoom floor to `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`, ensuring text rendering is still never smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display while allowing the entire panel to fit smoothly inside the screen; macOS remains unchanged.

body.zh-TW: 開啟 Windows 系統匣觀察各家 AI 用量，開著的面板現在絕不會無聲無息地停止更新。先前新增了 Grok 欄位之後，在英文介面且每家提供商額度皆滿 100% 的極端狀況下，提示文字長度會達到 129 個字元；這讓底層圖示套件 `pystray` 拋出 `ValueError: string too long` 錯誤，但該錯誤卻被背景工作常駐程式 `_refresh_worker()` 默默吞掉，連同該輪更新畫面的 `inject_state()` 也一併跳過，導致面板看似開著卻再也不會刷新數據。現在系統匣提示文字強制限制在 127 個字元以內，徹底防範字串過長引發的崩潰。⟦這種脫節宛如展場跑馬燈因文字過長當機，值班警衛不但沒回報還順手切斷訊號線，讓大廳螢幕默默停在上一輪舊畫面。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows tray to check AI usage across providers, an open panel will no longer silently stop updating. The tray tooltip text is now strictly capped at 127 characters, completely preventing crashes caused by excessively long strings. ⟦This disconnection is like an exhibition marquee crashing from text that is too long, and instead of reporting it, the duty guard casually disconnects the signal cable, leaving the lobby display quietly frozen on the previous frame.⟧

title.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列與接續提醒自動換新，補齊修復並校準版號
title.en: Terminal status line and session resume hooks update automatically, incorporating fixes and aligning version numbers

body.zh-TW: 先前已在電腦中安裝過狀態列與工作階段接續提醒的使用者，現在升級時會自動替換成最新版腳本。過去這兩支 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）雖然歷經多次修改，涵蓋狀態列進位的 `1000k` 修正以及 7 月以來工作階段接續提醒的十項修正，卻因為未調升版號，讓既有安裝一直留在舊檔案。新版將狀態列升級至 1.6 版、接續提醒升級至 1.7 版，安裝程式會主動用最新副本覆蓋舊檔，並新增自動化測試確保腳本版號與安裝常數隨時步調一致。⟦這恰似圖書館借閱處更新了服務規章，封皮上的版本代號卻漏未換新，讓館員誤以為抽屜裡積滿灰塵的舊手冊仍是現行規定。⟧
body.en: Users who previously installed the status line and session resume hooks on their systems will now have them automatically replaced with the latest script versions upon upgrading. # 3. Default path ~/.claude

```
# Moves with the variable: settings.json, .claude.json, projects/

```

entries: **AI Talent Market.** The panel browsed a curated set of subagent personas and installed them into `~/.claude/agents/`. entries: **Grok now appears in the report and the interactive dashboard.** The menu bar has carried a Grok quota card for a while and `loaders/grok_loader.py` could already produce per-call token detail, but there was no `adapters/grok.py`, so both `usage report` and the dashboard were blind to it. The adapter was added along with the four lookup tables that have to agree: the registry's detector list, the `AGENT_LOADERS` maps in `usage_cli` and `reporter`, and `AGENT_SHORT` / `AGENT_LABEL` in `ui/tables`.

**The report breaks tokens into four kinds and shows each tool's cache hit rate.** The headline "tokens burned" was one number summing four different things; locally, 93.8% of a 2,565,454,499-token period was `cache_read` and only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, so the total said nothing. `UsageEntry` has always carried all four fields and `loaders/disk_cache_common.py` serialized all four — `reporter` was dropping them when it built the summary, so no cache and no schema version had to change. Cache hit rate is `cache_read / (input + cache_creation + cache_read)`; output is excluded because it is generated, not sent in. A high rate is the healthy end — old context reused at roughly a tenth of the price instead of re-sent at full rate — and the copy in all five languages is written to keep it from being read as "most of my tokens are wasted repeats."

**"One-pass rate" is now a section of its own, third from the top.** Whether the AI finished without you stepping in is a measure with no pre-LLM equivalent; the data was already computed and already drawn, but it sat in a small card inside "usage habits" in section 11, where most people never scrolled. It is now a full section placed after Insights and before Tools, and the model rows use the report's existing rank-line layout sorted by pass rate rather than by turns — the question the section answers is which model needs the least going back over, not which one is used most. No new i18n keys were required.

**The AI roundtable can pick Codex's Astra model.** `gpt-6-astra` is Codex's new default, but the roundtable's model allowlist hard-coded the three 5.6 variants. Pricing and the report needed no change: LiteLLM's table already carries real prices in all four of its fields, and the report's color assignment matches on the `gpt` prefix.

**"Cost burned" is now "API equivalent."** The label presented a figure multiplied out from list prices as money actually spent, which is misleading for subscription users whose marginal cost is zero. Renamed in all five languages; the Traditional Chinese-only NTD conversion went with it, since that ran an assumed figure through an exchange rate a second time. The number itself stays — API users still need it. The two headline cards never shared a denominator: "tokens burned" counts every agent, while "API equivalent" can only count models with a published price, so a subtitle now explains the gap, and only when unpriced tokens actually exist.

**Token composition is a ranked list instead of a stacked bar.** With one category at 93.8%, the other three collapsed into invisible slivers, the in-bar percentage labels piled up into `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` at the left edge, and the legend's swatches had no size styling at all. A stacked bar is the wrong chart once a single category passes ninety percent, and the four are not peers anyway — input, cache write and cache read are all context sent in, output is generated. Each category now gets its own row with its own columns, and the bar's 2% minimum width keeps a 0.7% share visible. Per-tool cache hit rates use the same layout, sorted by rate, so the weakest tool is the last row rather than something you have to hunt for.

**The report's data rows are filled bars, with columns that line up across every section.** Four separate problems: the two row systems (`.rank-line` and `.tool-row`) used different track widths and gaps, so numbers sat at different x positions in different sections; the share bar was a child of `.name` and capped by the name column, so it drew to about half the row and stopped; every section nested a section frame, a card frame and a row frame; and two sections used the shared layout with no column headers. The tools section had no bar element at all and now has one, with each tool's color keyed on its agent id rather than its sort position — `by_agent` is ordered by tokens, so a palette indexed by position would repaint every tool whenever two swapped places.

**The weekly burn section lost its daily line chart.** It had no scale and no values, did not match the "weekly" heading it sat under, and could not be read for anything actionable. The rows below it, carrying week number, value and week-over-week change, are unchanged.
**The top KPI row no longer repeats the one-pass rate.** Five cards laid out badly in a two-column grid, and the full section below already carries the per-model detail.

**The report says which span it is comparing against.** "vs. last month" and "vs. last week" became a single "vs. previous period," and the annual block is now "last 53 weeks" with the week count supplied by `WrappedReportData.weeks` from `_YEAR_WEEKS`, so the copy follows the constant if it ever changes.

**The quota warning fits inside the panels.** The red "running out" line was `white-space: nowrap` and needed 320–470px, but the panels' text box is 304–320px and the cards are `overflow: hidden` — deliberate retro chrome, not removable — so the sentence was cut off. Measured across 13 panels × 5 languages: Japanese lost 81–150px, and only three panels' English fit. The wording is now shorter with the same meaning. The World Cup panel gets an even shorter variant that omits the reset time, since its head-to-head layout leaves each side only 151px.

**The year ledger is never silently discarded.** `_read_year_ledger()` had four paths that returned an empty ledger, the worst being a `schema_version` mismatch: anyone changing a ledger field and bumping the version would have quietly zeroed every user's accumulated history, with no backup to recover from. This file exists precisely so that history survives after the raw logs rotate away, so clearing it defeats the thing it is for. Measured during development: one version bump took the local heatmap from 119 days to 36. A mismatched version now logs a warning and parses day by day anyway — `_year_day_from_json` already tolerates missing fields — and only a genuinely unreadable or structurally wrong file is moved into `~/.usage/quarantine/` before returning empty, matching what the disk cache already does.

**A git worktree whose main repo is bare no longer splits one project into two.** `resolve_project_name()` resolved the worktree back to its main path and took the basename, so the project name carried a `.git` suffix. `adapters/claude.py` parses paths without calling git and reported `obsidian00`, while the other three loaders went through `project_resolver` and reported `obsidian00.git`; locally that was 5997 entries against 3732, and the report listed one project twice, at 21.70% and 10.80%. The same bug sat in three layers: the resolver now strips a trailing `.git`, Codex's shard cache went from schema 4 to 5 so the 28 shards holding the old name are re-parsed, and the year ledger — which cannot be invalidated by a version bump without losing the only copy of that history — folds `X.git` back into `X` at read time instead.

**Token units no longer skip a tier when they round up.** `_fmt_tokens` picked the tier from the raw value and rounded afterwards without re-checking, so 999,950 printed as `1000.0K` and 999,950,000 as `1000.0M`.

**A type error in the token composition tests.** `data["summary"]` and the elements of `data["by_agent"]` are TypedDicts, so mypy rejects a loop variable used as a key; the two assertions now go through an `Any` intermediate. The lines came from the composition work and were not caught earlier because that batch had not been pushed yet.

title.zh-TW: Grok 登上用量報表與互動儀表板，四張對照表同步補齊
title.en: Grok arrives in usage reports and the interactive dashboard with four synchronized lookup tables

body.zh-TW: 平時習慣呼叫 Grok 協作的開發者，現在執行 `usage report` 或切換至互動儀表板時，終於能將它的用量一併納入統計。⟦這好比商場服務台早早掛出新專櫃的會員卡，樓層指南與各收銀機名冊卻全漏記，消費者看全館總表時始終找不到它；把各處對照表補齊後才完整歸隊。⟧先前 macOS 選單列雖有 Grok 的額度卡，讀取器 `loaders/grok_loader.py` 也能吐出逐次呼叫的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）明細，但轉接層缺少 `adapters/grok.py`，導致終端機報表與儀表板對它視而不見。這次除了補上轉接器，也同步了四張必須一致的對照表：註冊表的偵測清單、指令列與報表產生器的 `AGENT_LOADERS`，以及表格介面的 `AGENT_SHORT` 與 `AGENT_LABEL`。
body.en: Developers who regularly collaborate with Grok can now finally include its usage in statistics when running `usage report` or switching to the interactive dashboard. ⟦This is like a mall information desk displaying membership cards for a new boutique while the floor directory and register rosters omit it entirely, leaving shoppers unable to find it on the mall-wide directory until lookup tables everywhere are completed.⟧ While the macOS menu bar previously had a Grok quota card and the loader `loaders/grok_loader.py` could produce per-call token details, the adapter layer lacked `adapters/grok.py`, leaving the terminal report and dashboard blind to it. In addition to adding the adapter, this update synchronizes the four lookup tables that must agree: the registry's detector list, `AGENT_LOADERS` in the CLI and report generator, and `AGENT_SHORT` and `AGENT_LABEL` in the table UI.

items.original: **Grok now appears in the report and the interactive dashboard.** The menu bar has carried a Grok quota card for a while and `loaders/grok_loader.py` could already produce per-call token detail, but there was no `adapters/grok.py`, so both `usage report` and the dashboard were blind to it. The adapter was added along with the four lookup tables that have to agree: the registry's detector list, the `AGENT_LOADERS` maps in `usage_cli` and `reporter`, and `AGENT_SHORT` / `AGENT_LABEL` in `ui/tables`.

title.zh-TW: 報表細分四類 token 並顯示快取命中率，釐清真實消耗
title.en: Reports split tokens into four categories and display cache hit rates to clarify real consumption

body.zh-TW: 想掌握 AI 的實際消耗，過去報表頂部的「燒掉 Tokens」只把四種不同性質的數字加總成單一數值，根本看不出關鍵細節。⟦這好比水電帳單只印出一筆總度數，卻把洗澡水、澆花水與管線循環水全混在一起，讓人無法判斷用水習慣是否健康。⟧本機測試某期 2,565,454,499 個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）裡，高達 93.8% 是讀取快取的舊資料。快取就是把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接取用；模型真正生成的輸出只佔 0.7%，單看總額毫無意義。現在報表正式拆分為輸入、快取寫入、快取讀取與輸出四類，並計算各工具的快取命中率。算式以快取讀取除以三種輸入脈絡總額，排除掉生成出的輸出。高命中率代表舊脈絡以約十分之一的單價重複取用，五種語言的文案也明確引導此數值象徵體質良好而非無效重複。底層一直都記錄著這四個欄位，先前僅是報表彙整時丟棄，因此不必清理快取或升級資料格式。
body.en: To understand actual AI consumption, the headline "tokens burned" at the top of previous reports summed four distinct numbers into a single total, obscuring key details. ⟦This is like a water bill that only prints a single total usage while lumping shower water, garden water, and recirculated pipe water together, making it impossible to judge whether consumption habits are healthy.⟧ In local testing across a period of 2,565,454,499 tokens, as much as 93.8% was cache read while only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, rendering the raw total meaningless. The report now formally breaks down usage into input, cache write, cache read, and output, while calculating cache hit rates for each tool. The formula divides cache read by the sum of the three input contexts, excluding the generated output. A high hit rate indicates that old context is reused at roughly one-tenth the unit price, and the copy across all five languages explicitly frames this metric as a sign of healthy efficiency rather than wasteful repetition. The underlying layer has always recorded all four fields and previous versions merely discarded them during report aggregation, so no cache clearing or data format upgrade is required.

items.original: **The report breaks tokens into four kinds and shows each tool's cache hit rate.** The headline "tokens burned" was one number summing four different things; locally, 93.8% of a 2,565,454,499-token period was `cache_read` and only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, so the total said nothing. `UsageEntry` has always carried all four fields and `loaders/disk_cache_common.py` serialized all four — `reporter` was dropping them when it built the summary, so no cache and no schema version had to change. Cache hit rate is `cache_read / (input + cache_creation + cache_read)`; output is excluded because it is generated, not sent in. A high rate is the healthy end — old context reused at roughly a tenth of the price instead of re-sent at full rate — and the copy in all five languages is written to keep it from being read as "most of my tokens are wasted repeats."

title.zh-TW: 一次過關率獨立成報表第三區，頂部 KPI 卡不再重複顯示
title.en: One-pass rate becomes an independent third section in the report, removing duplicates from top KPI cards

body.zh-TW: 你想知道哪款模型最省心、最不需要你回頭反覆插手修正，「一次過關率」現在被拉升成報表第三區的獨立大板塊。這項衡量 AI 能否一次搞定任務的指標早就算好，先前卻埋在第 11 區「使用習慣」的小卡裡，多數人根本捲不到。如今它改排在洞察之後、工具之前，各模型採用排行列版面依過關率由高至低排序，直接回答哪款模型最不用重修，而非單看誰的對話輪次多。頂部關鍵績效指標（KPI，衡量核心表現的量化卡片）也同步移除了重複的一次過關率，解決過去五張卡硬塞在雙欄網格中的難看排版，而且沒有新增任何多國語系文字鍵。⟦這就像餐廳評鑑把「廚師一試成菜率」從附錄角落拉到首頁專欄，依退菜次數由少到多排列，頂部總覽區便無須再塞入重複的概括數字。⟧
body.en: For those wanting to know which model requires the least intervention and fewest follow-up fixes, "one-pass rate" has been promoted to a standalone third section in the report. This metric measuring whether AI completes tasks on the first attempt was already computed, but previously sat buried inside a small card under section 11 "usage habits" where most users never scrolled. It is now positioned after Insights and before Tools, with model rows using a ranked layout sorted by pass rate from highest to lowest to directly answer which model needs the fewest revisions rather than just looking at turn count. The top key performance indicator (KPI) cards also removed the duplicate one-pass rate, fixing an awkward layout where five cards were squeezed into a two-column grid without requiring any new i18n localization keys. ⟦This is like a restaurant guide moving the "chef first-try dish success rate" from an appendix corner to a front-page column sorted from fewest dishes sent back to most, eliminating the need to crowd redundant overview numbers into the header.⟧

items.original:
**"One-pass rate" is now a section of its own, third from the top.** Whether the AI finished without you stepping in is a measure with no pre-LLM equivalent; the data was already computed and already drawn, but it sat in a small card inside "usage habits" in section 11, where most people never scrolled. It is now a full section placed after Insights and before Tools, and the model rows use the report's existing rank-line layout sorted by pass rate rather than by turns — the question the section answers is which model needs the least going back over, not which one is used most. No new i18n keys were required.
**The top KPI row no longer repeats the one-pass rate.** Five cards laid out badly in a two-column grid, and the full section below already carries the per-model detail.

title.zh-TW: AI 圓桌納入 Codex 的 Astra 預設模型，名單不再寫死
title.en: AI roundtable incorporates Codex's default Astra model as the allowlist is no longer hardcoded

body.zh-TW: 召開 AI 圓桌讓多款模型共同商討問題時，你現在已能指派 Codex 最新的 Astra 模型加入對話。⟦這如同會議室名單原本寫死只邀三位資深代表，當新任首席代表上任時便被警衛攔在門外；把名冊放寬後，新代表就能直接入席開會。⟧`gpt-6-astra` 是 Codex 當前的新預設模型，但圓桌先前的模型白名單寫死了 5.6 版的三款舊變體，導致新旗艦無法登場。這次放行無須更動價目表與報表：LiteLLM 的價格表早已完整收錄該模型的四項實價，報表的顏色分配也只要命中 `gpt` 前綴就能自動對應，切換選擇毫無阻礙。
body.en: When convening an AI roundtable to deliberate issues across multiple models, you can now assign Codex's latest Astra model to the discussion. ⟦This is like a conference room roster that rigidly invited only three senior delegates, causing security to turn away the newly appointed chief delegate at the door until the list was opened up so the new representative could take a seat.⟧ `gpt-6-astra` is Codex's current new default model, but the roundtable's previous model allowlist hardcoded three older 5.6 variants, preventing the new flagship from appearing. Enabling it required no changes to pricing tables or reports: LiteLLM's price list already covers the model's four actual prices, and report color assignments match automatically on the `gpt` prefix, so switching works without another change.

items.original: **The AI roundtable can pick Codex's Astra model.** `gpt-6-astra` is Codex's new default, but the roundtable's model allowlist hard-coded the three 5.6 variants. Pricing and the report needed no change: LiteLLM's table already carries real prices in all four of its fields, and the report's color assignment matches on the `gpt` prefix.

title.zh-TW: 「燒掉成本」更名為「API 等值」，移除新台幣換算並以副標說明差額
title.en: "Cost burned" is renamed to "API equivalent", removing NTD conversion and clarifying gaps via subtitles

body.zh-TW: 每次打開報表看到「燒掉成本」這個標籤，往往讓人誤以為自己真的刷卡付出了這筆費用。這項數值僅是依照官方牌價乘出來的假設數字，對於每個月繳固定月費、邊際成本為零的包月使用者來說相當容易引起誤解。現在五種語言統一改名為「API 等值」，先前繁體中文特有的新台幣換算也一併移除，避免將假設數字再乘上匯率二次失真。該數值本身依然保留，供按量計費的 API 使用者參考。另外，由於「燒掉 Tokens」統計了所有代理工具，而「API 等值」僅能計算具備公開牌價的模型，兩張頭條卡的分母並不相同；因此只有在確實出現無牌價用量時，卡片才會顯示副標題說明兩者的差額。⟦這有如健身房月費會員查看運動手環時，熱量消耗換算出的「外食便當等值金額」僅供參考，若標示成「你今天花掉的餐費」反而會讓人誤以為荷包失血。⟧
body.en: Opening the report and seeing the "Cost burned" label often gave the mistaken impression that one had actually paid that amount out of pocket. Because this figure is merely a hypothetical number multiplied out from official list prices, it easily misled subscription users who pay a fixed monthly fee with zero marginal cost. The label is now unified across all five languages as "API equivalent", and the NTD conversion previously unique to Traditional Chinese has been removed to avoid distorting an assumed number a second time through exchange rates. The value itself remains available for pay-as-you-go API users who need it. Furthermore, because "tokens burned" counts all agents while "API equivalent" can only calculate models with published list prices, the two headline cards do not share the same denominator; a subtitle now explains the gap, but only when unpriced usage actually exists. ⟦This is like a monthly gym member looking at a fitness tracker where burned calories are converted into an "equivalent dining-out cost" for reference, which would falsely imply wasted money if labeled as "money spent on meals today."⟧

items.original: **"Cost burned" is now "API equivalent."** The label presented a figure multiplied out from list prices as money actually spent, which is misleading for subscription users whose marginal cost is zero. Renamed in all five languages; the Traditional Chinese-only NTD conversion went with it, since that ran an assumed figure through an exchange rate a second time. The number itself stays — API users still need it. The two headline cards never shared a denominator: "tokens burned" counts every agent, while "API equivalent" can only count models with a published price, so a subtitle now explains the gap, and only when unpriced tokens actually exist.

title.zh-TW: Token 組成與快取命中改採排行列，微小比例不再被壓扁
title.en: Token composition and cache hit rates switch to ranked lists, preventing tiny shares from collapsing

body.zh-TW: 當單一類別佔比超過九成時，傳統的堆疊長條圖就會變成一場排版災難。先前在快取讀取高達 93.8% 的情況下，其餘三種類別被壓成看不見的細縫，長條內的百分比文字甚至重疊成 `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` 擠在最左側，圖例色塊也缺乏尺寸樣式。輸入、快取寫入與快取讀取都屬於傳入的脈絡，而輸出是生成的文字，性質本不相同。現在改採排行列呈現，四種類別各自擁有獨立的一列與專屬欄位，且長條設有 2% 的最小寬度，讓僅佔 0.7% 的微小產出依然清晰可辨。各工具的快取命中率也套用同款版面依命中率排序，體質最差的工具直接落在最後一列。同時，測試中針對 TypedDict 型別以迴圈變數當鍵遭 mypy 拒絕的問題，也透過 `Any` 中介變數順利修復。⟦這好比大合照時體型差距懸殊、名牌全疊成一團，改成單人單列橫條後，每位成員的身形與名次才清晰可辨。⟧
body.en: When a single category exceeds ninety percent, traditional stacked bar charts turn into a layout disaster. Previously, with cache reads reaching 93.8%, the other three categories collapsed into invisible slivers, in-bar percentage text overlapped into `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` at the far left edge, and legend color swatches lacked sizing styles entirely. Input, cache write, and cache read all represent incoming context while output consists of generated text, making them fundamentally distinct in nature. The presentation has now shifted to ranked lines where each of the four categories receives its own row and dedicated columns, with bars given a 2% minimum width to keep even a tiny 0.7% output clearly visible. Per-tool cache hit rates adopt the same layout sorted by hit rate, placing the worst-performing tool on the final row. Meanwhile, a test issue where mypy rejected loop variables used as keys on TypedDict types was resolved cleanly using an `Any` intermediate variable. ⟦This is like a group photo where huge differences in size cause name tags to pile on top of each other, until switching to individual single-row bars makes every member's stature and standing clear.⟧

items.original:
**Token composition is a ranked list instead of a stacked bar.** With one category at 93.8%, the other three collapsed into invisible slivers, the in-bar percentage labels piled up into `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` at the left edge, and the legend's swatches had no size styling at all. A stacked bar is the wrong chart once a single category passes ninety percent, and the four are not peers anyway — input, cache write and cache read are all context sent in, output is generated. Each category now gets its own row with its own columns, and the bar's 2% minimum width keeps a 0.7% share visible. Per-tool cache hit rates use the same layout, sorted by rate, so the weakest tool is the last row rather than something you have to hunt for.
**A type error in the token composition tests.** `data["summary"]` and the elements of `data["by_agent"]` are TypedDicts, so mypy rejects a loop variable used as a key; the two assertions now go through an `Any` intermediate. The lines came from the composition work and were not caught earlier because that batch had not been pushed yet.

title.zh-TW: 報表資料列改為整列量條，跨區塊數值對齊同一基準線
title.en: Report data rows become full-width bars, aligning values across sections to a shared baseline

body.zh-TW: 檢視報表中不同區塊的數據時，數字與量條不再忽左忽右跳動。⟦這有如試算表裡多張工作表的直欄寬度各吹各的調，數字忽左忽右難以閱讀；重新劃定同一套格線並固定標籤顏色後，整份報表才整齊劃一。⟧過去排版存在四個獨立缺陷：兩套資料列樣式（`.rank-line` 與 `.tool-row`）因欄寬與間距相異，導致數值在各區塊落在不同的水平位置；佔比量條被限制在名稱欄內，只能畫到半列就硬生生中斷；每個區塊層層疊加了區塊、卡片與列框三層多餘邊界；更有兩處區塊缺少欄位表頭。現在資料列改為貫穿整列的進度條，工具區補上了量條元素，且工具的顏色直接綁定代理識別碼（agent id）而非排序位置，避免工具名次互換時發生整批重新塗色的混亂。
body.en: When reviewing data across different report sections, numbers and bars no longer jitter unpredictably between left and right. ⟦This is like a spreadsheet where multiple sheets use mismatched column widths that scatter numbers everywhere, until establishing a unified grid and consistent label colors brings the entire report into clean alignment.⟧ The previous layout suffered from four separate defects: two row styles (`.rank-line` and `.tool-row`) used differing column widths and gaps that placed numbers at different horizontal positions across sections; share bars were trapped inside the name column and abruptly stopped halfway across the row; every section stacked three redundant borders of section, card, and row frames; and two sections lacked column headers entirely. Data rows are now full-width progress bars, the tools section adds bar elements, and tool colors are keyed directly to the agent ID rather than sort position to avoid repainting every tool whenever rankings shift.

items.original: **The report's data rows are filled bars, with columns that line up across every section.** Four separate problems: the two row systems (`.rank-line` and `.tool-row`) used different track widths and gaps, so numbers sat at different x positions in different sections; the share bar was a child of `.name` and capped by the name column, so it drew to about half the row and stopped; every section nested a section frame, a card frame and a row frame; and two sections used the shared layout with no column headers. The tools section had no bar element at all and now has one, with each tool's color keyed on its agent id rather than its sort position — `by_agent` is ordered by tokens, so a palette indexed by position would repaint every tool whenever two swapped places.

title.zh-TW: 報表時間週期與對比標記更明確，移除無刻度的每日折線
title.en: Report timeframes and comparison markers gain clarity, removing scaleless daily line charts

body.zh-TW: 追蹤長期消耗趨勢時，報表展示的時間跨度如今更加清晰嚴謹。每週燃燒趨勢區塊移除了原本夾帶的每日折線圖，因該折線既無刻度也無具體數值，不但對不上「每週」的標題，也無法提供任何可化為行動的有效資訊；底下的週次、數值與週增減橫條則維持不變。同時，報表明確講清楚了比較的基準期間，將「較上月」與「較上週」統合成「較前期」；年度統計區塊也正名為「近 53 週」，其週數由程式常數自動傳入，日後常數調整時文案會即時跟上。⟦這彷彿帳單收據拿掉了沒有刻度與單位的裝飾性波動圖，只保留清楚的每週明細與增減數值，並把對照週期寫得一清二楚。⟧
body.en: When tracking long-term consumption trends, the report's timeframes are now clearer and more rigorous. The weekly burn trend section dropped its embedded daily line chart because it had no scale or values, failed to match the "weekly" heading, and provided no actionable information, while the week numbers, values, and week-over-week bars below remain unchanged. At the same time, the report clarifies its comparison baseline by unifying "vs. last month" and "vs. last week" into "vs. previous period", while the annual section is renamed "last 53 weeks" with the week count passed from program constants so the copy updates automatically if constants change. ⟦This is like a billing receipt stripping away decorative fluctuation charts lacking scales or units, keeping only clear weekly breakdowns with changes and explicitly stating the comparison period.⟧

items.original:
**The weekly burn section lost its daily line chart.** It had no scale and no values, did not match the "weekly" heading it sat under, and could not be read for anything actionable. The rows below it, carrying week number, value and week-over-week change, are unchanged.
**The report says which span it is comparing against.** "vs. last month" and "vs. last week" became a single "vs. previous period," and the annual block is now "last 53 weeks" with the week count supplied by `WrappedReportData.weeks` from `_YEAR_WEEKS`, so the copy follows the constant if it ever changes.

title.zh-TW: 配額警告文案精簡，完整塞入選單列面板不再被截斷
title.en: Quota warning copy streamlined to fit inside menu bar panels without truncation

body.zh-TW: 當你的模型額度即將用盡時，彈出的警告紅字現在能完整顯示於介面之中。先前那行寫死不換行的警語需要 320 到 470 像素寬度，但選單列面板（popover，點擊狀態列圖示展開的小視窗）的文字框僅有 304 至 320 像素，加上卡片外框設定了隱藏溢出內容以維持復古造型，整行紅字因此直接被切斷。實測 13 個面板在 5 種語言下的表現，日文最慘被削掉 81 至 150 像素，英文也只有三個面板能剛好裝下。現在文案在維持原意下全面縮短，左右對決的世界盃面板更提供省略重置時間的超短版本，完美適應每邊僅 151 像素的狹窄空間。⟦這如同行李吊牌框格尺寸固定，原本冗長的手寫警語硬塞進去只會被切掉後半截；換成精簡標語後，整行提示便完整呈現。⟧
body.en: When your model quota is running low, the red warning text now displays fully within the interface. Previously, the hardcoded nowrap warning required 320 to 470 pixels of width, but the menu bar panel text box was only 304 to 320 pixels, and because card frames hid overflowing content to preserve a retro aesthetic, the red line was cut off directly. Across 13 panels in 5 languages, Japanese suffered the most by losing 81 to 150 pixels, and English fit in only three panels. The copy is now universally shortened while preserving its original meaning, and the head-to-head World Cup panel provides an ultra-short variant that omits the reset time, fitting neatly into the narrow 151 pixels on each side. ⟦This is like a fixed-size luggage tag where lengthy handwritten warnings get cut off at the edge, but switching to a concise message displays the full reminder cleanly.⟧

title.zh-TW: 年度帳本不再因版本不合無聲清空，歷史紀錄妥善防護
title.en: Year ledger is no longer silently cleared on version mismatches, safeguarding historical records

body.zh-TW: 累積整整一年的 AI 使用紀錄，往後再也不會因為程式升級而無聲無息被歸零蒸發。⟦這就像圖書館換了新的索書號編碼規則，不能因此把整櫃舊藏書當垃圾直接倒掉，而應先照常上架供人借閱，只有真正碎成紙屑的殘卷才移至隔離室留存。⟧年度帳本模組原本有四條路徑會直接回傳空帳本，其中最嚴重的便是資料規格版本不符；過去只要開發者微調欄位並調升版號，全球使用者累積的歷史便會靜靜歸零，且毫無備份可救。開發時實測更發現，一次升版就讓本機熱力圖從 119 天驟降至 36 天。現在版本不符時只會記錄警告，依舊逐日解析舊資料；只有在檔案完全無法讀取或結構徹底損毀時，才會先隔離備份至 `~/.usage/quarantine/` 資料夾，周全守護歷史紀錄。
body.en: A full year of accumulated AI usage history will no longer vanish silently to zero due to software upgrades. ⟦This is like a library adopting new call number rules: it shouldn't discard entire shelves of older books as trash, but keep them on shelves for borrowing while reserving quarantine storage only for scrolls shredded beyond recognition.⟧ The year ledger module previously had four execution paths that returned an empty ledger, the most severe being schema version mismatches; whenever developers tweaked fields and bumped the version, users worldwide quietly lost their entire history with no backups to recover from. Testing during development revealed that a single version bump caused the local heatmap to plunge from 119 days to 36. Version mismatches now merely log a warning and continue parsing older data day by day, moving files into the `~/.usage/quarantine/` directory as isolated backups only when they are genuinely unreadable or structurally corrupted to protect historical records.

items.original: **The year ledger is never silently discarded.** `_read_year_ledger()` had four paths that returned an empty ledger, the worst being a `schema_version` mismatch: anyone changing a ledger field and bumping the version would have quietly zeroed every user's accumulated history, with no backup to recover from. This file exists precisely so that history survives after the raw logs rotate away, so clearing it defeats the thing it is for. Measured during development: one version bump took the local heatmap from 119 days to 36. A mismatched version now logs a warning and parses day by day anyway — `_year_day_from_json` already tolerates missing fields — and only a genuinely unreadable or structurally wrong file is moved into `~/.usage/quarantine/` before returning empty, matching what the disk cache already does.

title.zh-TW: 裸倉庫工作樹不再把同專案拆成兩筆，清理後綴並修復歷史
title.en: Bare repo worktrees no longer split one project into two, cleaning suffixes and repairing history

body.zh-TW: 在裸倉庫（沒有工作目錄的 Git 主儲存庫）中建立工作樹時，同一專案往後不再被報表拆成兩筆紀錄。先前專案名稱解析器將工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）路徑解回主目錄後直接取尾端名稱，讓專案名多帶了 `.git`。這使純路徑解析的 Claude 回報 `obsidian00`，其餘三組讀取器卻回報 `obsidian00.git`；本機實測達 5997 筆對 3732 筆，報表上同一專案被拆成 21.70% 與 10.80% 兩筆。三層架構已同步修復：解析器會去除結尾的 `.git`，Codex 分片快取升版以重新解析 28 個舊分片，年度帳本則在讀取時將 `.git` 摺疊併回原專案名。⟦這恰似同一家分公司只因招牌多印了副檔名，就被會計帳冊當成兩家企業分開記帳；統一歸併後數據才合而為一。⟧
body.en: When creating a worktree from a bare repository, the same project will no longer be split into two separate entries in reports. Previously, the project name resolver resolved worktree paths back to the main directory and took the basename directly, leaving the project name with an unwanted `.git` suffix. This caused path-only Claude to report `obsidian00` while the other three loaders reported `obsidian00.git`; locally, this amounted to 5997 entries against 3732, splitting the same project in the report into 21.70% and 10.80%. All three architectural layers have been fixed: the resolver strips the trailing `.git`, the Codex shard cache was bumped to re-parse 28 old shards, and the year ledger folds `.git` back into the base project name at read time. ⟦This is just like a branch office being logged as two separate businesses in accounting ledgers simply because its sign had a file extension printed on it, until unified consolidation merges the figures back together.⟧

items.original: **A git worktree whose main repo is bare no longer splits one project into two.** `resolve_project_name()` resolved the worktree back to its main path and took the basename, so the project name carried a `.git` suffix. `adapters/claude.py` parses paths without calling git and reported `obsidian00`, while the other three loaders went through `project_resolver` and reported `obsidian00.git`; locally that was 5997 entries against 3732, and the report listed one project twice, at 21.70% and 10.80%. The same bug sat in three layers: the resolver now strips a trailing `.git`, Codex's shard cache went from schema 4 to 5 so the 28 shards holding the old name are re-parsed, and the year ledger — which cannot be invalidated by a version bump without losing the only copy of that history — folds `X.git` back into `X` at read time instead.

title.zh-TW: Token 單位進位不再跳級錯誤，四捨五入後自動重新校準
title.en: Token units no longer miscalculate tiers on round-up, recalibrating automatically after rounding

body.zh-TW: 當你的 token 消耗量剛好接近單位級距的邊緣時，報表上的數字與單位現在會正確跳級。⟦這就像電子磅秤在物體達九百九十九點九五公克時進位，數值跨入整數，單位標籤卻沒跟著切換而秀出「一千點零克」；重新校準級距後，便會準確切換成一公斤。⟧函式 `_fmt_tokens` 過去在格式化 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數值時，先根據未縮放的原始值決定單位級距，完成縮放並執行四捨五入後，卻沒有再次檢查數字是否已經滿額進位。這導致 999,950 遭到四捨五入後被印成古怪的 `1000.0K`，而 999,950,000 也被印成 `1000.0M`。現在進位後會重新審查級距，確保單位如實躍升。
body.en: When your token consumption nears the boundary of a unit tier, numbers and units on reports will now advance correctly. ⟦This is like a digital scale rounding up at 999.95 grams into a whole number but failing to switch unit labels and showing "1000.0 grams", until recalibrating the tier correctly flips the display to one kilogram.⟧ When formatting token values, the `_fmt_tokens` function previously selected unit tiers from unscaled raw values, but failed to re-check whether rounding pushed the number across the tier threshold after scaling. This caused 999,950 to be printed as an awkward `1000.0K` after rounding, and 999,950,000 as `1000.0M`. Unit tiers are now re-evaluated after rounding to ensure units advance properly.

items.original: **Token units no longer skip a tier when they round up.** `_fmt_tokens` picked the tier from the raw value and rounded afterwards without re-checking, so 999,950 printed as `1000.0K` and 999,950,000 as `1000.0M`.

entries: **Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard with consistent labels.** The dashboard and `usage report` maintain separate agent-to-loader maps, and only the report map included `antigravity`, so a detected Antigravity installation opened a dashboard tab that rendered `No data` even though the report command could load its usage. The terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving their headings as the raw lowercase agent ID. The maps had no parity check, and the first regression test hard-coded the three known agents instead of comparing the two maps, so it could not keep their keys synchronized; it now asserts exact key equality. Reported and fixed by @ClarenceKuo in #126.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 用量能顯示在互動儀表板了，表格名稱不再只留小寫代號
title.en: Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard, and table headers no longer stay as raw lowercase IDs

body.zh-TW: 你在 `usage` 查詢用量時，若裝有 Antigravity，過去切到互動儀表板只會看到 `No data` 的空白分頁。⟦這就像停車場管理處明明有登錄，出口繳費機卻自備名冊且漏記新車號，讓車主在螢幕上只查到「查無資料」，欄位也只印出底盤代號。⟧問題在於儀表板與 `usage report` 各自維護代理到載入器的對照表，先前只有報表納入 `antigravity`，即便報表指令能載入用量，偵測到安裝的儀表板分頁依然只渲染出 `No data`；終端機表格也缺少 Antigravity 的簡稱與顯示名稱，欄位標題只能留著原始小寫代理 ID。兩份對照表過去缺乏一致性檢查，最初的迴歸測試（防範舊功能被改壞的自動驗證）甚至直接寫死三款已知代理而未比對雙方清單，無法維持鍵值同步；現在測試已強制要求兩邊鍵值完全相等。
body.en: When checking usage with `usage`, if Antigravity was installed, switching to the interactive dashboard previously only showed a blank tab with `No data`. ⟦This is like a parking office having a vehicle registered, but the exit payment machine keeps its own roster and misses the new plate number, leaving the driver seeing "No data" on screen while fields only print raw chassis codes.⟧ The problem was that the dashboard and `usage report` each maintained separate agent-to-loader mapping tables. Previously, only the report included `antigravity`, so even though the report command could load usage, the dashboard tab for a detected installation still rendered `No data`. Terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving column headers stuck with the raw lowercase agent ID. The two mapping tables previously lacked consistency checks, and the initial regression tests (automated checks preventing existing features from breaking) even hard-coded three known agents instead of comparing both lists, failing to keep keys synchronized; tests now enforce exact key equality across both sides.

items.original: **Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard with consistent labels.** The dashboard and `usage report` maintain separate agent-to-loader maps, and only the report map included `antigravity`, so a detected Antigravity installation opened a dashboard tab that rendered `No data` even though the report command could load its usage. The terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving their headings as the raw lowercase agent ID. The maps had no parity check, and the first regression test hard-coded the three known agents instead of comparing the two maps, so it could not keep their keys synchronized; it now asserts exact key equality. Reported and fixed by @ClarenceKuo in #126.

entries: **The TUI launches from the app bundle again.** `rich` was listed in py2app's `includes`, which collects only what its static import graph can see — but `rich/_unicode_data/__init__.py` loads its per-version Unicode width tables through `import_module()` at render time, so the bundle shipped that package carrying `__init__` and `_versions` alone and `usage --tui` died with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rich._unicode_data.unicode17-0-0'` on the first table it drew. Menu bar mode, which never renders through `rich`, was unaffected. `rich` is now a `packages` entry, which copies the whole tree instead of the reachable parts of it. Reported by @dvakatsiienko in #125.

**Fable 5.1 has an offline price, and the fallback table's own audit no longer skips the entire Fable family.** Claude Code 2.1.257 made Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) the default of the Fable line, but the hard-coded fallback table only carried `claude-fable-5`, so whenever the downloaded price table was missing or stale every Fable 5.1 token was costed at $0. Its cache-read price is `0.25e-6` — a quarter of Fable 5's — so inheriting the older entry would not have been correct either. The gap went unreported because `scripts/check_fallback_pricing.py` matched only `opus|sonnet|haiku`: no `fable` model, old or new, was ever in scope for the audit that exists to catch exactly this.

**A dated model no longer falls back to a newer version's pricing.** `_resolve_model_key` matched any table key that started with the queried name followed by a hyphen, so `claude-opus-4-20250514` resolved to `claude-opus-4-6` and was costed at $5/M instead of $15/M — a third of the real figure — whenever the offline table was in use. A query that already carries its own version number now rejects a candidate that merely appends another digit, while a version-less name like `claude-sonnet` still resolves, and among equally specific keys the newest version wins. Named variants (`gpt-5` → `gpt-5-pro`) are unaffected. The five models still in service that the table had never carried — `claude-opus-4`, `claude-opus-4-1`, `claude-opus-4-5`, `claude-sonnet-4`, `claude-sonnet-4-5` — were added, and a Bedrock version suffix is now stripped so `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0` prices correctly.

**The fallback pricing audit reports what actually fails to resolve, instead of a list nobody could act on.** Both directions of `compare_pricing` diffed raw dictionary keys, but the fallback table drops date suffixes on purpose — so models that price perfectly well, such as `claude-haiku-4-5` and `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`, were reported as missing. Three of the twelve reported gaps were false, the script's exit code had been 1 for as long as that was true, and a real gap was indistinguishable from the noise. Both directions now resolve through `_resolve_model_key`.
**The usage table shows a name for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1.** `MODEL_SHORT` had no entry for either, so both were printed as their raw model IDs.

**Quota warnings now fire at 50% as well as 90%, and one reading sends at most one notification.** Codex 0.153.0 began warning Plus and Team users once a five-hour window is less than half remaining; usage waited until 90%, so the tool it monitors warned earlier than the monitor did. The default is now `[50.0, 90.0]` on macOS and Windows alike, still overridable through `quota_notification_thresholds`. Because a single reading can cross both thresholds at once — the app launching when quota is already at 95%, or a single large jump — only the highest crossed threshold sends a notification and the rest are latched, so one observation never produces two alerts saying the same thing.

title.zh-TW: macOS 應用程式套件的文字介面又能開了，字寬表完整打包不閃退
title.en: The TUI launches from the macOS app bundle again, packing complete character width tables without crashing

body.zh-TW:
從 macOS 應用程式套件啟動終端文字介面時，畫面不再因缺漏字寬資料而當場閃退。⟦出門施工若只帶工具本體，漏掉夾層裡的零件，到現場就無法開工；整箱連同配件帶齊才不缺件。⟧打包工具 py2app 原本把 `rich` 列在 `includes`，只收集靜態引用掃得到的檔案。但 `rich/_unicode_data/__init__.py` 是在繪圖當下以 `import_module()` 動態載入各版本 Unicode 字寬表，導致打包出的 app 僅帶了 `__init__` 與 `_versions`，一畫第一張表格就當場崩潰：
```
usage --tui  # 拋出 ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rich._unicode_data.unicode17-0-0'
```
不經過 `rich` 渲染的選單列模式不受影響。現在 `rich` 改列在 `packages`，整包目錄直接複製而非只收掃得到的片段，文字介面（TUI，終端文字操作畫面）恢復正常。
body.en:
When launching the terminal text user interface from the macOS app bundle, the screen no longer crashes on the spot due to missing character width data. ⟦If you head out to a job site carrying only the main tool while leaving the parts in the compartment behind, you cannot start work once you arrive; bringing the whole case along with all accessories ensures nothing is missing.⟧ The packaging tool py2app previously listed `rich` under `includes`, collecting only files reachable by static import scans. However, `rich/_unicode_data/__init__.py` dynamically loads per-version Unicode width tables via `import_module()` at render time, causing the packaged app to carry only `__init__` and `_versions` and crash immediately upon drawing the first table:
```
usage --tui  # throws ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rich._unicode_data.unicode17-0-0'
```
Menu bar mode, which does not render through `rich`, is unaffected. `rich` is now listed under `packages` so the entire directory is copied directly rather than only scanned fragments, restoring the text user interface (TUI) to normal.

Menu bar mode, which never renders through `rich`, was unaffected. `rich` is now a `packages` entry, which copies the whole tree instead of the reachable parts of it. Reported by @dvakatsiienko in #125.

title.zh-TW: Fable 5.1 補上離線備援價格，對帳腳本不再整族跳過
title.en: Fable 5.1 gains offline fallback pricing, and the audit script no longer skips the entire family

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 2.1.257 起將 Fable 5.1（`claude-fable-5-1`）設為預設，離線計價缺口如今補齊。先前寫死的備援價目表只有 `claude-fable-5`，每當下載價目表缺失或過期，Fable 5.1 的每個 token（AI 計費單位）都被算成 $0。它的快取重讀價是 `0.25e-6`，只有 Fable 5 的四分之一，沿用舊資料也不正確。此缺口過去未被察覺，因 `scripts/check_fallback_pricing.py` 只比對 `opus|sonnet|haiku`，不論新舊皆跳過 Fable 家族。現在 Fable 5.1 已補上離線價格，對帳腳本也納入稽核。⟦保險費率表漏記新車的備援費率，斷線時計價直接歸零，查帳員還只抽查舊車；現在費率與稽核皆已補齊。⟧
body.en: Claude Code 2.1.257 set Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) as the default, and the offline pricing gap is now filled. The hard-coded fallback price table previously only contained `claude-fable-5`, so whenever the downloaded price table was missing or expired, every Fable 5.1 token was costed at $0. Its cache-read price is `0.25e-6`, only a quarter of Fable 5's, so inheriting older data would also be incorrect. This gap went unnoticed in the past because `scripts/check_fallback_pricing.py` only matched `opus|sonnet|haiku`, skipping the Fable family regardless of whether models were old or new. Now Fable 5.1 has its offline price added, and the audit script includes it in checks. ⟦An insurance rate sheet missed fallback rates for new car models, resetting pricing to zero during outages while auditors only sampled old cars; now both the rates and audit coverage are complete.⟧

title.zh-TW: 帶日期模型不再退回新版價格，補齊五款服役中模型
title.en: Dated models no longer fall back to newer version pricing, adding five active models

body.zh-TW:
查詢帶日期的舊模型離線價格時，程式不再誤退回到較新版本的便宜價格。⟦公車站牌若只看開頭數字，想搭四號公車的乘客會被載上四之六號新線；現在完整對齊路線才放行。⟧先前 `_resolve_model_key` 只要鍵名以查詢字串加連字號開頭就算命中。這讓 `claude-opus-4-20250514` 被解析成 `claude-opus-4-6`，離線時每百萬 token（AI 計費單位）算 $5 而非真實的 $15，只有真實費用的三分之一。現在查詢自帶版本號時，不再接受追加尾數的候選；無版本號的泛稱如 `claude-sonnet` 照舊解析得到，同等具體程度取較新版本，具名變體（gpt-5 到 gpt-5-pro）不受影響。表裡原本缺失但仍在服務的五個模型一併補上，並剝除 Bedrock 版本後綴讓查詢正確計價：
```
claude-opus-4
claude-opus-4-1
claude-opus-4-5
claude-sonnet-4
claude-sonnet-4-5
claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0  # 剝除 Bedrock 後綴（v1:0）後正確計價
```
body.en:
When querying offline prices for older dated models, the program no longer mistakenly falls back to the cheaper price of a newer version. ⟦If a bus stop sign only looks at the leading digit, passengers looking for Bus 4 would be carried onto the newer 4-6 line; now the full route must match before letting them board.⟧ Previously, `_resolve_model_key` counted any key starting with the query string followed by a hyphen as a hit. This caused `claude-opus-4-20250514` to resolve to `claude-opus-4-6`, costing $5 per million tokens offline instead of the actual $15—only one-third of the real cost. When a query carries its own version number, candidates with an appended trailing digit are no longer accepted. Generic names without version numbers like `claude-sonnet` still resolve as before, picking the newer version among equally specific keys, while named variants (`gpt-5` to `gpt-5-pro`) remain unaffected. Five models still in service that were previously missing from the table have been added, and Bedrock version suffixes are stripped so queries price correctly:
```
claude-opus-4
claude-opus-4-1
claude-opus-4-5
claude-sonnet-4
claude-sonnet-4-5
claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0  # prices correctly after stripping Bedrock suffix (v1:0)
```

title.zh-TW: 備援價目表對帳改採解析比對，消除誤報與常態錯誤結束代碼
title.en: Fallback pricing audit switches to resolution matching, eliminating false positives and persistent error exit codes

body.zh-TW: 檢查備援價目表的對帳腳本現在只回報解析失敗的模型，不再給出一份無人能處理的混亂清單。先前 `compare_pricing` 兩個方向都用字面鍵名相減，但備援價目表本就刻意不帶日期後綴。這讓明明算得出價格的模型（例如 `claude-haiku-4-5` 與 `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`）都被報成缺漏。回報的 12 筆缺口有 3 筆是假的，腳本的結束代碼也因此長期為 1，真的缺口混在雜訊裡看不出來。現在兩個方向都改用 `_resolve_model_key` 判斷。⟦門禁警報若死板比對整串卡號，刻意省略換證日期的合格卡全被誤報成黑名單，警示燈常亮反而掩蓋了真正的闖入者；改採對照解析後才恢復平靜。⟧
body.en: The audit script checking fallback pricing tables now only reports models that actually fail to resolve, rather than outputting a confusing list that no one could act on. Previously, `compare_pricing` diffed raw literal keys in both directions, even though the fallback table deliberately omits date suffixes. This caused models that could calculate prices perfectly well (such as `claude-haiku-4-5` and `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`) to be flagged as missing. Three of the 12 reported gaps were false, keeping the script's exit code at 1 persistently and making real gaps indistinguishable from the noise. Both directions now evaluate models through `_resolve_model_key`. ⟦If an access control alarm rigidly compares full card numbers, valid cards deliberately omitting renewal dates get falsely flagged as blacklisted, and a constantly lit warning light ends up masking real intruders; switching to lookup resolution restores calm.⟧

items.original: **The fallback pricing audit reports what actually fails to resolve, instead of a list nobody could act on.** Both directions of `compare_pricing` diffed raw dictionary keys, but the fallback table drops date suffixes on purpose — so models that price perfectly well, such as `claude-haiku-4-5` and `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`, were reported as missing. Three of the twelve reported gaps were false, the script's exit code had been 1 for as long as that was true, and a real gap was indistinguishable from the noise. Both directions now resolve through `_resolve_model_key`.

title.zh-TW: 用量表格顯示 Opus 5 與 Fable 5.1 簡稱，不再只印原始代號
title.en: Usage table displays short names for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 instead of raw model IDs

body.zh-TW: 打開終端機檢視用量表格時，畫面本該為各個模型顯示簡短易讀的名稱，方便一眼掌握用量分佈。但先前簡稱字典 `MODEL_SHORT` 裡缺少了 Opus 5 與 Fable 5.1 這兩款新條目，導致表格在列出用量時，只能直接印出長串的原始模型代號（raw model IDs），讓整行排版顯得雜亂又難以閱讀。現在用量表格已補齊這兩款模型的對照設定，會正確顯示簡短名稱。⟦手機通訊錄若漏填好友姓名，來電時螢幕只能秀出一長串電話號碼；補上暱稱後，一眼就能認出是誰撥來。⟧
body.en: When opening the terminal to view usage tables, the screen should display short, readable names for each model to help grasp usage distribution at a glance. However, the short-name dictionary `MODEL_SHORT` previously lacked entries for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1, forcing the table to print long raw model IDs and making the layout cluttered and difficult to read. The usage table now includes mapping entries for both models, displaying clean short names properly. ⟦If a phone contact list misses a friend's name, incoming calls only show a long phone number on the screen; once the nickname is added, you can recognize who is calling at a glance.⟧

items.original: **The usage table shows a name for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1.** `MODEL_SHORT` had no entry for either, so both were printed as their raw model IDs.

title.zh-TW: 配額提醒提早至用掉一半即發送，單次讀數最多一則通知
title.en: Quota warnings fire earlier at 50% usage, sending at most one notification per reading

body.zh-TW: 你的配額通知現在會提早跳出提醒，且單次讀數絕不連續送出兩則重複通知。Codex 0.153.0 起，五小時視窗剩不到一半就會提醒 Plus 與 Team 使用者。但 `usage` 先前等到 90% 才提醒，等於被監控的工具比監控端還早出聲。預設門檻在 macOS 與 Windows 一致改為 `[50.0, 90.0]`，仍可透過 `quota_notification_thresholds` 自行調整。單次讀數可能一口氣跨過兩個門檻，例如 app 在配額已達 95% 時才啟動，或用量單次大跳；這時只有跨過的最高門檻會發送通知，其餘標記為已通知並鎖定，一次觀測絕不冒出兩則重複提醒。⟦河川警戒在水位達一半與九成時各廣播一次，若暴雨讓水位瞬間破九成，警報只響最緊急的紅燈，不重複播送低階警訊。⟧
body.en: Your quota alerts now trigger earlier, and a single reading never sends two consecutive duplicate notifications. Starting with Codex 0.153.0, Plus and Team users are warned once less than half of the five-hour window remains. However, `usage` previously waited until 90% before alerting, meaning the monitored tool warned earlier than the monitor itself. The default threshold is now consistently set to `[50.0, 90.0]` across macOS and Windows, while remaining customizable via `quota_notification_thresholds`. A single reading can cross both thresholds at once, such as when the app launches with quota already at 95% or during a single large usage jump. In this situation, only the highest crossed threshold sends a notification while the rest are latched as notified, ensuring one observation never generates two duplicate alerts. ⟦A river warning system broadcasts once at half and once at ninety percent water levels; if a torrential storm pushes water past ninety percent instantly, only the most urgent red alert sounds without replaying lower-level warnings.⟧

items.original: **Quota warnings now fire at 50% as well as 90%, and one reading sends at most one notification.** Codex 0.153.0 began warning Plus and Team users once a five-hour window is less than half remaining; usage waited until 90%, so the tool it monitors warned earlier than the monitor did. The default is now `[50.0, 90.0]` on macOS and Windows alike, still overridable through `quota_notification_thresholds`. Because a single reading can cross both thresholds at once — the app launching when quota is already at 95%, or a single large jump — only the highest crossed threshold sends a notification and the rest are latched, so one observation never produces two alerts saying the same thing.

entries: **Self-heal no longer takes over a user's own script that merely shares part of a hook's filename.** Both the hook-removal path and the migration path that keeps an installed hook's command current used a plain substring check against markers like `usage-terse-mode`, so a user's own script — say, a backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py` — matched and was silently rewritten to the official command. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`; the same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.

**Language detection no longer misreads plain English words as Japanese or Korean, or a made-up Chinese-script tag as a real one.** The `_normalize_lang` logic — duplicated across four files — matched `ja`/`ko` with an unbounded `startswith`, so `jargon` and `koala` were read as Japanese and Korean; a POSIX `@modifier` suffix wasn't stripped, so `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English; and `zh-HK` didn't accept further BCP 47 subtags the way `zh-TW`/`zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant`/`zh-Hans` (letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese) and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix (dropping a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` tag to English). All four duplicated copies now require a boundary after every prefix.

**A non-UTF-8 terminal no longer crashes terse mode or session resume, and a truncated or corrupted version marker no longer wedges self-heal.** The SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks wrote JSON without `ensure_ascii`, so a terminal using an encoding like cp950 raised `UnicodeEncodeError` and lost the entire message; output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. The four version-marker readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, which meant a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. Separately, a stale terse-mode sidecar whose content had rotted was never rebuilt as long as the hook version hadn't changed, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it's now checked by validating the sidecar's content.

**Session resume's stdin and stdout failures are handled the same way its sibling hooks already were, and a corrupted newest session log falls back to an older one instead of going silent.** `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe, and unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume didn't catch it — an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. Separately, `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt disappear instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did.

**The health-check reminder's own state write no longer takes the whole resume prompt down with it, a bare punctuation reply is no longer read as a real request, and a newly created but uncommitted directory now shows up in the "not saved yet" list.** Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` (a full disk, a permissions error) and that exception propagated out far enough to swallow the main resume prompt along with it; it's now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. Separately, `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary.

**A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done.** The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored, and the next session's resume prompt kept reporting work that was already finished.

**The quota-restored notification fires again, and a warning now fires on the very first reading if quota is already past the threshold.** Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation, and the restored notification never fired. It's now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — for instance, the app launching mid-session at 95% — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.

**A dead plist key was removed, and a Windows registry read failure can no longer take down the whole tray menu.** `StartDelay` isn't a key `launchd.plist(5)` recognizes, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added; it's gone. Separately, the Windows login-item's `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`, but it's called once per menu render to draw the "launch at login" checkbox — a registry permission error there propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled."

**Terse mode's plain-language rule now also covers text pasted verbatim from a subagent.** The mode's own prompt only governed sentences Claude wrote itself, leaving no instruction for handling a subagent's report or a tool's raw output when quoted directly — jargon inside it went unexplained. A line was added after the existing "explain a term on first use" rule, in all five languages.

title.en: Self-heal stops taking over your own script that just looks like a hook

title.zh-TW: 英文單字不再被當成日文或韓文
title.en: Plain English words are no longer read as Japanese or Korean

body.zh-TW: 語言代碼是拿來標示介面該講哪種語言的短代號，`ja` 是日文、`ko` 是韓文。`usage` 判斷代碼時只看開頭幾個字母就算數，於是 `jargon` 被讀成日文、`koala` 被讀成韓文。另外幾種寫法也判錯：`zh_TW@variant` 因為沒有先去掉 `@` 後面那段而掉回英文；`zh-HK` 不像 `zh-TW` 那樣接受後面再加細分代碼。再查一輪還發現 `zh-Hant` 和 `zh-Hans` 有同樣的開頭比對問題，亂編的 `zh-Hantasy` 也會被當成繁體中文，而缺了 `zh-SG-` 這個開頭讓合法的 `zh-SG-x-private` 掉成英文。這段判斷在四個檔案裡各有一份，現在四份都要求開頭之後有明確邊界。⟦查字典時只憑前兩個字母就翻到某一頁，`jar` 開頭的字全被歸進同一欄；現在得把整個詞對完才算。⟧
